units.note: Gov. Bill Walker (I) suspended his campaign and endorsed Mark Begich (D) but remained on the ballot; his votes are not counted in the D-side.
Ned Lamont: fusion lines Democratic Party (United States) + Working Families Party summed. Bob Stefanowski: fusion lines Republican Party (United States) + Independent Party of Connecticut summed.

Andrew Cuomo: fusion lines Democratic Party (United States) + Working Families Party + Independence Party of New York + Women's Equality Party (New York) summed. Marc Molinaro: fusion lines Republican Party (United States) + Conservative Party of New York State + Reform Party of New York State summed.
